raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What
Nightly tests for DSV4 HiSparse + HiCache in 1P1D over MoRI, for Pro and Flash, FP4 and FP8: HiCache on prefill, HiSparse on decode. Added to `nightly-configs.yaml`.

Launcher: a `disable_radix_cache: false` knob (HiCache needs the radix cache on), and a recipe's `*_extra_env` is now applied after the DSV4 env so it can override it.

Recipe notes:
- Decode uses `--disable-overlap-schedule`: the overlap scheduler intermittently desyncs the decode TP request broadcast.
- Prefill is capped at 262144 tokens and 9217 context, decode at 1M tokens. Without the prefill cap, prefill runs out of GPU memory on the first real batch. Without the decode cap, the HiSparse host pool is too large for transparent hugepages.

## Depends on
#45494, #29168, #32368, merged in that order. This one merges last.

## Validation
MI355X, 2 nodes, ROCm 10 image `v0.5.22-rocm10-mi35x-20261018` with those PRs applied: all four recipes complete concurrency 1 to 256 with no errors. GSM8K: Flash FP4 0.965, Pro FP4 0.975, Flash FP8 0.950, Pro FP8 0.985. Flash FP4 also passes 64k-context needle retrieval (40/40). To re-run after the dependencies land in main.

nodes.body:
Ran all four recipes on hardware: 2-node 1P1D, MI355X, `mia1-p02-g29` prefill + `g53` decode, each on the checkpoint its entry names.

| recipe | GSM8K | invalid | ibv_reg_mr failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mi355x-fp4/dsv4pro | 0.950 | 0.000 | 0 |
| mi355x-fp8/dsv4pro | 0.945 | 0.005 | 0 |
| mi355x-fp4/dsv4flash | 0.950 | 0.000 | 0 |
| mi355x-fp8/dsv4flash | 0.950 | 0.000 | 0 |

The stack under test was #29168 → #32368 plus a host-pointer fix. We also built #32368 + #35233 on its own, with a rebuilt gfx950 `sgl_kernel` and no #36966 in the tree, and pro-fp4 scored 0.970 there — so #35233 covers what these recipes need, and #36966 can be closed.

What the recipes now carry, measured rather than guessed:

- **decode host pool on 2MiB pages.** One ionic pd holds about 1M 4K page-table entries, roughly 4 GiB. The pool is larger, so `ibv_reg_mr` fails with `errno:22` partway through and the decode scheduler aborts. On 2MiB pages the same pool registers clean: 100 GiB on one pd against 3.75 GiB on 4K.
- **Flash decode capped at the Pro token budget.** The host pool is the budget over four, and Flash budgets 26.2M against Pro's 12.3M, so an uncapped decode wants 174 GB per rank, 1.4 TB over eight.
- **Flash prefill at `--hicache-ratio 1.2`.** At 2 the c4 indexer pool is left 3.67 GB and prefill dies. `--hicache-size` is not a way out; the DSV4 path rejects it.
- **Flash prefill at `mem_fraction_static 0.78`.** At 0.85 it is left about 0.5 GiB of VRAM and the first lazily loaded Triton kernel has no room. `hipModuleLoadData` then reports `hipErrorNoBinaryForGpu`, which is about space, not the arch.

The recipes are the run command — full flags and env for both roles — at `scripts/ci/slurm/recipes/mi355x-{fp4,fp8}/dsv4{pro,flash}/1k1k/1p1d-hisparse-hicache.yaml` in [this PR](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37200/files).

+# MI355X DeepSeek-V4-Flash (FP4) 2-node 1P1D combining BOTH memory features in one
+# PD leg: HiCache on the PREFILL role + HiSparse on the DECODE role, KV transfer
+# over MORI, unified-KV layout.
+#
+# FP4 is driven by the nightly block precision: fp4 (launcher sets
+# SGLANG_DSV4_FP4_EXPERTS); no fp4-specific flag belongs in this recipe.
+#
+# The two features live on opposite roles by design and do not conflict:
+#   * HiCache is prefill-only  (a decode server never prefills; pd_disaggregation_hook
+#                               forces disable_radix_cache=True on decode anyway).
+#   * HiSparse is decode-only  (prefill keeps the dense C4 source layout,
+#                               hisparse_hook:107).
+#
+# Requires three PRs, in order (none merged into the image yet, so this leg runs
+# via SGLANG_USE_CHECKOUT_RUNTIME=1 against a tree that contains all three):
+#   #29168  unified-KV HiSparse on ROCm         (removes the unified-KV guard,
+#                                                 adds HiSparseUnifiedC4DevicePool)
+#   #32368  HiSparse PD over MoRI               (the PD/cross-node KV transfer;
+#                                                 declares "based on #29168")
+#   #36966  device-alias pointer fix            (both features hit the same
+#                                                 DeepSeekV4PagedHostPool; without
+#                                                 it, GPU-faults at PD warmup /
+#                                                 backup on non-SVM host kernels)
+#
+# Measured 2026-09-11, 2-node 1P1D on mia1-p02-g29 + g53, exactly as configured
+# here: GSM8K 0.950, 0 invalid, 0 ibv_reg_mr failures, 161 decode batches. The
+# three Flash-only settings below are all needed; Pro's values kill both roles.
+#
+# The launcher auto-adds --enable-dp-attention/--dp-size, --moe-a2a-backend/
+# --deepep-mode, and the DSV4 parser flags; only the feature flags below are
+# recipe-specific.
+
+resources:
+  prefill_workers: 1
+  decode_workers: 1
+
+backend:
+  sglang_config:
+    prefill:
+      tensor-parallel-size: 8
+      expert-parallel-size: 8
+      data-parallel-size: 8
+    decode:
+      tensor-parallel-size: 8
+      expert-parallel-size: 8
+      data-parallel-size: 8
+
+runtime:
+  image: lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.18-rocm724-mi35x-20260826
+  attention_backend: dsv4
+  moe_a2a_backend: mori
+  kv_transfer_backend: mori
+  # HiSparse host-RDMA needs all 8 rails + rank-local IB (env below).
+  ib_devices: rdma0,rdma1,rdma2,rdma3,rdma4,rdma5,rdma6,rdma7
+  dist_socket_ifname: eno0
+  prefill_port: 30025
+  decode_port: 30026
+  prefill_bootstrap_port: 8998
+  decode_bootstrap_port: 9001
+  lb_port: 8000
+  mem_fraction_static: 0.85
+  page_size: 256
+  max_running_requests: 192
+  chunked_prefill_size: 65536
+  swa_full_tokens_ratio: 0.1
+  # Required for the HiCache (prefill) side: --disable-radix-cache is otherwise
+  # hardcoded into both role strings, and hierarchical-cache + disable-radix-cache
+  # is a hard ValueError. HiCache L1 *is* the radix cache. In practice only prefill
+  # is affected: pd_disaggregation_hook still forces disable_radix_cache=True on the
+  # decode role, which is what the HiSparse decode side wants.
+  disable_radix_cache: false
+  wide_ep:
+    kv_cache_dtype: fp8_e4m3
+    # PREFILL: HiCache. hicache-ratio 2 matched validation; if the PD device pool
+    # makes the host budget too large ("Not enough host memory"), switch to an
+    # absolute --hicache-size (GB per rank) as the dsr1 leg does.
+    # At ratio 2 the pool leaves 3.67 GB for the c4 indexer pool and prefill dies.
+    # --hicache-size is not an alternative: the DSV4 path rejects it.
+    prefill_extra_flags: "--context-length 9217 --max-total-tokens 262144 --enable-hierarchical-cache --hicache-ratio 1.2 --hicache-io-backend kernel --hicache-mem-layout layer_first"
+    # DECODE: HiSparse. device_buffer_size 2048 sizes the device C4 pool so
+    # requests admit (hisparse_req_budget > 0).
+    # Host pool = token budget / 4. Flash budgets 26.2M against Pro's 12.3M, so an
+    # uncapped decode wants 174 GB per rank, 1.4 TB over eight -- past the
+    # reservation. At Pro's budget the pool is 65 GB per rank and fits.
+    decode_extra_flags: "--max-total-tokens 1000000 --disable-overlap-schedule --enable-hisparse --hisparse-config '{\"top_k\":1024,\"device_buffer_size\":2048,\"host_to_device_ratio\":2}'"
+    # At 0.85 Flash prefill is left with ~0.5 GiB of VRAM and the first lazily
+    # loaded Triton kernel has no room; hipModuleLoadData then reports
+    # hipErrorNoBinaryForGpu, which is about space, not the arch. Decode is fine
+    # at the shared value.
+    prefill_mem_fraction_static: 0.78
+    prefill_extra_env:
+      SGLANG_HACK_FLASHMLA_BACKEND: unified_kv_triton
+      MORI_RDMA_TC: 104
+      MORI_IO_TC: 104
+      MORI_RDMA_SL: 3
+      MORI_IO_SL: 3

+      SGLANG_MORI_HOST_REGISTRATION_CHUNK_BYTES: 268435456
+      SGLANG_ENABLE_HEALTH_ENDPOINT_GENERATION: 0
+      # One ionic pd holds about 1M 4K page-table entries, roughly 4 GiB. The host
+      # pool is larger, so ibv_reg_mr fails with errno:22 and decode aborts. On
+      # 2MiB pages it registers clean: 100 GiB on one pd against 3.75 GiB on 4K.
+      # STRICT=1 because a silent fallback to 4K pages brings the crash back

+      SGLANG_HUGEPAGE_SIZE: 2MB
+      SGLANG_HUGEPAGE_STRICT: 1

+bench:
+  concurrencies: [1, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256]

issue_comments.body:
Ran all four recipes on hardware: 2-node 1P1D, MI355X, `mia1-p02-g29` prefill + `g53` decode, each on the checkpoint its entry names.

| recipe | GSM8K | invalid | ibv_reg_mr failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mi355x-fp4/dsv4pro | 0.950 | 0.000 | 0 |
| mi355x-fp8/dsv4pro | 0.945 | 0.005 | 0 |
| mi355x-fp4/dsv4flash | 0.950 | 0.000 | 0 |
| mi355x-fp8/dsv4flash | 0.950 | 0.000 | 0 |

The stack under test was #29168 → #32368 plus a host-pointer fix. We also built #32368 + #35233 on its own, with a rebuilt gfx950 `sgl_kernel` and no #36966 in the tree, and pro-fp4 scored 0.970 there — so #35233 covers what these recipes need, and #36966 can be closed.

What the recipes now carry, measured rather than guessed:

- **decode host pool on 2MiB pages.** One ionic pd holds about 1M 4K page-table entries, roughly 4 GiB. The pool is larger, so `ibv_reg_mr` fails with `errno:22` partway through and the decode scheduler aborts. On 2MiB pages the same pool registers clean: 100 GiB on one pd against 3.75 GiB on 4K.
- **Flash decode capped at the Pro token budget.** The host pool is the budget over four, and Flash budgets 26.2M against Pro's 12.3M, so an uncapped decode wants 174 GB per rank, 1.4 TB over eight.
- **Flash prefill at `--hicache-ratio 1.2`.** At 2 the c4 indexer pool is left 3.67 GB and prefill dies. `--hicache-size` is not a way out; the DSV4 path rejects it.
- **Flash prefill at `mem_fraction_static 0.78`.** At 0.85 it is left about 0.5 GiB of VRAM and the first lazily loaded Triton kernel has no room. `hipModuleLoadData` then reports `hipErrorNoBinaryForGpu`, which is about space, not the arch.

The recipes are the run command — full flags and env for both roles — at `scripts/ci/slurm/recipes/mi355x-{fp4,fp8}/dsv4{pro,flash}/1k1k/1p1d-hisparse-hicache.yaml` in [this PR](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37200/files).

@HaiShaw We have tested the HiCache + HiSparse stack together on 2-node MI355X, with HiCache on prefill, HiSparse on decode, and KV transfer over MoRI. All four DSV4 configurations (Flash/Pro, FP4/FP8) completed concurrency 1–256 with no errors; GSM8K was 0.950–0.985. Flash FP4 also passed 64k-context needle retrieval (40/40).
